_comment: HARD PRUNES (2026-10-28, ledger 'Hard prunes + known-top blind test'): Ponder's plan-level fan is KEEP (the scored
best order) vs SHUFFLE, and the situational layer shuffles only when NO Cyclone is available -- a Cyclone REVEALED
by the Ponder counts as found and must not be shuffled away (USER: 'if we have no Cyclone we need to be aggressive
about searching for it'). Round 3, main 1, land drop made: Steam Vents, Mountain and four Islands out, Ponder and
Street Wraith in hand, NO Cyclone. Ponder looks at Island, Unpredictable Cyclone, Emrakul: the keep order draws the
Cyclone now with Emrakul next (the walk's first creature), then Cyclone ({3}{R}{R}) and the Wraith's cycle walk to
Emrakul (extra turn, 15 flying) kill the 15-life opponent in ROUND 3. Shuffling instead loses the round-3 kill.
